item.title: Carroll County Route B Bridge Deck Complete
item.description: The Bridge Deck Replacement project on Route B in Carroll County is complete, and the bridge is now open. The Missouri Department of Transportation’s contractor completed the bridge deck replacement project on the Route B bridge over Sambo Creek, south of Wakenda, on Tuesday. The bridge had been closed since Nov. 17th, 2025.

item.title: November Missouri Jobs Report
item.description: The State’s Jobs report for November was released today. Due to the Federal Government Shutdown, the October report has been skipped. The November report shows Missouri’s non-farm payroll increased by 5,500 jobs, private industry employment increased by 4,100 jobs, and government employment increased by 1,400 jobs.
